study: 十板块TRIX加入中证全指120日均线过滤研究
start_rule: First calendar quarter start after youngest ETF listing with at least 53 actual prior quote rows in every ETF; 2022-04-01 verified as 55 prior quotes for youngest. If not satisfied use next quarter start, never choose by return.

capital_rules: 10 initially equal cash sleeves; each invests only its own ETF or cash.
No cross-sleeve lending, reallocation, rebalancing, leverage, shorts, contributions or withdrawals.
Profits, losses and dividend cash remain in each sleeve; sector weights drift.
Standalone controls separately start with full 100000 CNY, to compare same total capital accounting for minimum fees.

TRIX.rule: entry on eligible upcross, exit on eligible downcross; prior state carried otherwise; initial state false

SKDJ.rule: 9-row raw RSV, EMA3 twice for K, SMA3 for D; eligible upcross enters, downcross exits; no thresholds or fixed maximum holding

signals.prior_quotes: Use all frozen available real quote history per asset; 53 is eligibility floor not truncation. Four reused ETF histories begin at their listing; six newly collected series begin 2021-01-04 or later listing. No fabricated observations for missing days.
signals.corporate_action_adjustment: Causal forward continuity adjustment only from effective ex-date: split factor*=ratio, cash dividend factor*=previous raw close/(previous raw close-d). Apply same factor to OHLC. This is not a dividend reinvestment performance series. No future adjustment rewrites earlier indicator state.
signals.execution: Signals from last completed actual quote at or before previous market day; execute next market day real raw open. Delayed stress uses two-market-day lag and delays initial HOLD entry one day too.
signals.legacy_SKDJ_note: The inherited feature builder also computes SKDJ for regression compatibility; this extension trades TRIX only.

costs.slippage_rule: max(open*rate,tick*ticks), buy rounded up and sell down to tick

corporate_actions.dividend_entitlement: Registration-day end-of-day actual holdings; record only, no extra equity on record day.
corporate_actions.ex_date: Before trading recognize locked original eligible shares * original per-share distribution as receivable. Later sales or splits do not change locked entitlement.
corporate_actions.payment: Published payment trading day credits cash AFTER trading, usable next market open. Non-market payment credits before the next market session. Receivable is reduced exactly once; payment itself does not increase equity.
corporate_actions.split: On official ex-date, multiply shares by verified integer ratio and divide stale per-share mark. Do not use supplier registration date as ex-date.
corporate_actions.concurrency: Abort preparation if same asset has cash dividend and split on same ex-date; require explicit unit review.
corporate_actions.hold_dividends: HOLD/HALF_HOLD buy once and retain dividend cash; timing models do not top up while holding but can spend available dividends at next entry.
corporate_actions.terminal: No forced liquidation; equity includes valid unpaid dividends as receivables; no final exit cost charged.

missing_quotes: No fill on missing/nonpositive-amount bar; prior known close marks with appropriate ex-action adjustment, marked stale. Present main interval has no missing bars.
fixed_period_rule: Fresh capital at each period start with pre-period legitimate indicator state carried; periods are equal calendar half-years, not selected turning points.
metrics: same fixed half-period and cost/delay stresses
limitations: Current surviving funds selected in 2026; not a historical full-market available universe.
Previous related technical results already observed; no truly unseen out-of-sample test.
Independent trade decisions do not imply independent price risk; no low correlation claim assumed.
Daily open and explicit slippage do not certify executable depth. Check order size against full-day amount and modeled fills outside daily range.
No fundamental filter, per-sector parameter optimization or future-best-sector selection in this experiment.
Cash distribution evidence source tiers and unexhausted negative-action archives must be disclosed.
The market filter is proposed after observing the previous sample; no truly unseen out-of-sample validation.
Broad-index total-return references are theoretical and close-to-close; main account returns include initial opening trades and costs.

market_filter.allowed: current completed close strictly greater than arithmetic mean of latest 120 actual trading closes; equality disallows
market_filter.alignment: exact decision_date observation required; missing/insufficient history aborts, never silently forward-filled
market_filter.ENTRY_GATE: if actual shares are zero, target=sector_long AND market_allowed; if shares positive, target=sector_long
market_filter.FULL_GATE: target=sector_long AND market_allowed regardless of current holdings
market_filter.reentry: underlying sector TRIX state always updates; reopened gate may buy while sector state remains long without requiring a fresh cross
market_filter.initial: fresh cash at each account start; both pre-period sector and market history retained
market_filter.timing: both sector and market observed at same decision_date; execute next market open (2 days for delayed stress)
market_filter.no_optimization: one chosen index and MA120 only; no ranking, relative-strength or fundamental filter

benchmark.clock: common first study date close to final date close; strategy equity is renormalized from its first close for this comparison only
benchmark.costs: official total-return theoretical reference, no fees or ETF tracking; distinct from executable account comparison
